title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E2 — Breakfast
Dutch baby pancake; oven-baked French toast; quiche made with peas and ham; cheese, ham and onion strata.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E6 — Pies
Peach crumble pie; key lime pie baked in a Graham cracker crust; coconut cream pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E8 — Cupcakes
Four cupcake recipes: blueberry swirl, lemon meringue, red velvet with cream cheese frosting, and one-bite double Diablo.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E7 — Fishmonger
Seafood chef Dave Pasternack explains buying, butchering and storing fish; boning a round or flat fish; cleaning a squid; crudo.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E8 — Sauteing
Dredging meat or fish in flour, then cooking over high heat to ensure a golden-brown finish; wiener schnitzel; chicken piccata; sole a la meunière; pan sauces.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E9 — Dumplings
Italian dumplings gnocchi and gnudi; Polish pierogi.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E10 — Grains
An overview of popular grains including quinoa and bulgur wheat and how to cook them.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S3 E13 — Muffins
Giant bran muffins filled with raisins; citrusy mini orange muffins; healthy morning muffins; plum-filled coffee cake muffins; glazed zucchini muffins.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E1 — Citrus
Orange chiffon cake; Shaker lemon pie; lime squares with pistachio Graham cracker crust; upside-down cake made with three kinds of citrus.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E2 — Northeast
Cranberry tart with currant jelly and cognac; mini chocolate whoopie pies; New York crumb cake; babka.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E3 — Pumpkin
Pumpkin pecan pie; cheesecake swirled with pumpkin; pumpkin bread; deep dish pumpkin pie.

title: Martha Bakes
description:

Traditional linzertorte; oatmeal cookies with a peanut butter filling; walnut cake; pecan tart.

Six-layer chocolate cake filled with salted caramel; dulce de leche; pound cake with caramel glaze; chocolate-caramel bar cookies.

Ruffled milk pie; Moroccan meat pie; baklava; spanakopita.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S4 E9 — Southern
Banana cream pie; coconut cake; spoon bread; pecan tassies.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E1 — Martha Hosts a Derby Party
Kevin Sharkey makes mint juleps and deviled eggs; a Churchill Downs Racetrack centerpiece; chef Pierre Schaedelin walks Martha through food preparation for the party; Martha gets fitted by hat milliner Jackie Ciconga for the perfect Derby ensemble.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E2 — The Art of Raw Food
Martha and Omar Abou-Ismail make miso soup and a bean-free hummus with flatbread made with raw ingredients; Martha and Omar whip up a tabouli salad followed by sweet potato fries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S2 E21 — Decorative Pastry; Clay Pots; Pie Kit Gift
Pottery maker Guy Wolff; pie-recipe gift; decorative pastry.

Begonias; fortune cookies; seven-minute frosting; cut roses.
